info.title: Cartesia Turn-Detecting Speech-to-Text WebSocket API
info.description:
Realtime speech transcription with built-in turn detection

<Note>
`ink-2` supports English, French, Hindi, Japanese, and Spanish. `ink-preview` supports [44 languages](/use-the-api/stt/languages).
Both detect the language automatically.
</Note>

model.description:
ID of the model to use for transcription: `ink-2` or `ink-preview`.

See [Models](/build-with-cartesia/stt/latest) for details.

sample_rate.description: The sample rate of the audio in Hz, from 8000 to 48000

language_hint.description:
Used by `ink-preview` only. `ink-2` returns an error.

A language to steer transcription toward. Hints don't stop the model from transcribing other languages.

To pass several, repeat the `language_hint` query parameter. You can pass up to 6. Use base codes from [Languages](/use-the-api/stt/languages), such as `pt`, not `pt-BR`. `language_hints` is also accepted as an alias.

Example: `?language_hint=hi&language_hint=en`

See [Languages](/use-the-api/stt/languages#language-hints) for details.

turn_start_threshold.description:
Threshold above which the turn starts. Default: 0.8. Range: 0.5–0.9. Must stay above `turn_eager_end_threshold`.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

turn_eager_end_threshold.description:
Threshold below which `turn.eager_end` fires. Default: 0.6. Range: 0.3–0.8. Must stay between `turn_end_threshold` and `turn_start_threshold`.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

turn_end_threshold.description:
Threshold below which the turn ends. Default: 0.3. Range: 0.05–0.5. Must stay below `turn_eager_end_threshold`.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

turn_end_timeout_ms.description:
The longest the model waits after the user stops speaking before it ends the turn, in milliseconds. Default: 5600. Range: 640–11200.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

keyterm.description:
Key terms that help the model recognize specific words and phrases.

To pass several, repeat the `keyterm` query parameter. `ink-preview` accepts up to 500 keyterms totaling 5,000 characters. `ink-2` accepts up to 100 totaling 1,200. To boost one multi-word phrase, join the words with `%20`. `keyterms` is accepted as an alias.

URLs longer than about 8 KB are rejected with HTTP 414. With `ink-preview`, send long lists in a `config` message after you connect.

Example: `?keyterm=Ink%202&keyterm=Cartesia`

See [Keyterm prompting](/use-the-api/stt/keyterms) for details.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: API key for trusted server applications.

accessToken.name: access_token
accessToken.description: Short-lived token for browser and mobile applications.

STTTurnsAudioData.name: STTTurnsAudioData
STTTurnsAudioData.title: Send Audio Data
STTTurnsAudioData.description:
Send raw audio as binary WebSocket messages, in small chunks such as 100 ms.

The audio must match the `encoding` and `sample_rate` query parameters.

STTTurnsCloseCommand.name: STTTurnsCloseCommand
STTTurnsCloseCommand.title: Close Command
STTTurnsCloseCommand.description: Send a JSON formatted `close` command as a WebSocket text message to close the session cleanly. The model processes all buffered audio into events.

STTTurnsConfigCommand.name: STTTurnsConfigCommand
STTTurnsConfigCommand.title: Config Command
STTTurnsConfigCommand.description: Change turn detection settings, keyterms, or language hints mid-stream

STTTurnsConnected.name: STTTurnsConnected
STTTurnsConnected.title: Connected
STTTurnsConnected.description:
Fires once when the WebSocket connection opens.

You don't need to wait for this event before sending audio.

STTTurnsTurnStart.name: STTTurnsTurnStart
STTTurnsTurnStart.title: Turn Start
STTTurnsTurnStart.description:
Marks the start of a user turn. Fires soon after the user starts speaking.

Use this event to interrupt your agent so it doesn't talk over the user.

STTTurnsTurnUpdate.name: STTTurnsTurnUpdate
STTTurnsTurnUpdate.title: Turn Update
STTTurnsTurnUpdate.description: Fires repeatedly as the model transcribes the current user turn.

STTTurnsTurnEagerEnd.name: STTTurnsTurnEagerEnd
STTTurnsTurnEagerEnd.title: Turn Eager End
STTTurnsTurnEagerEnd.description: Fires when the model predicts that the user might be done speaking.

STTTurnsTurnResume.name: STTTurnsTurnResume
STTTurnsTurnResume.title: Turn Resume
STTTurnsTurnResume.description: Fires after `turn.eager_end` if the user turn has not actually ended.

STTTurnsTurnEnd.name: STTTurnsTurnEnd
STTTurnsTurnEnd.title: Turn End
STTTurnsTurnEnd.description: Marks the end of a user turn.

STTErrorResponse.name: STTErrorResponse
STTErrorResponse.title: Error Response
STTErrorResponse.description: Error information for STT WebSocket connections

STTTurnsAudioData.description: Raw audio as a binary message, in the format set by the `encoding` parameter. Send it in small chunks, such as 100 ms.

type.description: Command type. Send this as a JSON formatted WebSocket text message to close the session.

STTTurnsCloseCommand.description: Send a JSON formatted `close` command as a WebSocket text message to close the session cleanly. The model processes all buffered audio into events.

type.description:
Command type. Send this as a JSON formatted WebSocket text message to update model settings.

Changes take effect right away, including for words not returned yet. There's no reply on success. An invalid message returns an `error` event, changes nothing, and leaves the connection open.

start_threshold.description:
Threshold above which the turn starts. Default: 0.8. Range: 0.5–0.9. Must stay above `eager_end_threshold`.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

eager_end_threshold.description:
Threshold below which `turn.eager_end` fires. Default: 0.6. Range: 0.3–0.8. Must stay between `end_threshold` and `start_threshold`.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

end_threshold.description:
Threshold below which the turn ends. Default: 0.3. Range: 0.05–0.5. Must stay below `eager_end_threshold`.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

end_timeout_ms.description:
The longest the model waits after the user stops speaking before it ends the turn, in milliseconds. Default: 5600. Range: 640–11200.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

keyterms.description:
`ink-preview` only. Replaces the session's keyterms. `[]` clears them, and leaving the field out keeps them. The limits are the same as at connect time.

See [Change keyterms mid-stream](/use-the-api/stt/keyterms#change-keyterms-mid-stream).

language_hints.description:
`ink-preview` only. Replaces the session's language hints, up to 6. `[]` clears them, and leaving the field out keeps them.

See [Change hints mid-stream](/use-the-api/stt/languages#change-hints-mid-stream).

STTTurnsConfigCommand.description: Change turn detection settings, keyterms, or language hints mid-stream

STTTurnsConnected.description:
Fires once when the WebSocket connection opens.

You don't need to wait for this event before sending audio.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this connection. Does not change between turns.

turn_id.description: Identifies the turn. Every event in a turn has the same `turn_id`, and each new turn gets a new one.

STTTurnsTurnStart.description:
Marks the start of a user turn. Fires soon after the user starts speaking.

Use this event to interrupt your agent so it doesn't talk over the user.

transcript.description: All text transcribed so far in the current turn, not just the new text

words.description:
`ink-preview` only. Every complete word in the turn so far, with timestamps. A word joins the list once the model has heard all of it, and it never changes after that. So during a turn, `words` can trail `transcript`. Left out when there are none.

See [Word timestamps](/use-the-api/stt/word-timestamps).

word.description: The word with any punctuation attached. `ink-whisper` words can start with a space.

start.description: Start time in seconds, counted from the start of the audio sent on the connection

end.description: End time in seconds, counted from the start of the audio sent on the connection

turn_id.description: Identifies the turn. Every event in a turn has the same `turn_id`, and each new turn gets a new one.

STTTurnsTurnUpdate.description: Fires repeatedly as the model transcribes the current user turn.

transcript.description: All text transcribed so far in the current turn. It can be empty. Don't start a reply for an empty transcript. See [Turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns).

words.description:
`ink-preview` only. Every word in the turn, with timestamps. Left out when there are none.

See [Word timestamps](/use-the-api/stt/word-timestamps).

start.description: Start time in seconds, counted from the start of the audio sent on the connection

end.description: End time in seconds, counted from the start of the audio sent on the connection

languages.description:
`ink-preview` only. The languages spoken in the turn, highest confidence first. It lists the languages the model is confident about, or only the most likely one if it isn't confident about any. If it's left out, treat the language as unknown.

See [Detected languages](/use-the-api/stt/languages#detected-languages).

confidence.description: How confident the model is that this language was spoken, from 0 (not confident) to 1 (very confident).

SpeechToTextTurnsEncoding.description:
The encoding of the raw audio you send. The server uses it to read your audio.

For help choosing an encoding, see [Audio Input](/build-with-cartesia/stt/audio-input).
